gate.unmapped: This view's component {id} is not mapped to a module
gate.fix: Add them under `mapping:` in `{file}` — one line per component, `{shape}`, where `module` is the name `chains.yaml` gives it.
browser.title: Deck {side}
browser.search: Search for an artist, a title…
browser.emptySet: The set is empty — add songs to songs.yaml.
browser.notCached: not in this machine's cache yet
loop.outFirst: an IN has to be put down first
loop.length: loop {beats} beats — the same button closes it
loop.roll: a {beats}-beat roll — hold it; the record picks up where it would be
bpm.none: the engine found no tempo for this song
bpm.driven: driven by the other deck — moving it cancels the sync
bpm.fader: tempo — double-click to go back to the song's own
bpm.pastRange: past a deck's range — the stretch is audible
bpm.halve: half: the detected tempo is twice the real one
bpm.double: double: the detected tempo is half the real one
bpm.noTempo: no tempo measured on this deck
bpm.corrected: the media library carries a corrected tempo for this song — it follows the record into every project
bpm.key: the song's key: {key} — typed into the media library, it follows the record
bpm.keylockOn: pitch held: the song keeps its key, but the stems no longer sum cleanly
bpm.keylockOff: pitch free: the song rises with the tempo, like a record
fx.censor: censor deck {side} — the record runs backwards while the button is held
fx.censorEmpty: deck {side} is empty — nothing to censor
fx.echoOut: echo-out on deck {side} — cuts the channel and lets the echo ring
fx.noEcho: this deck has no echo wired — connect `deck{side}.echo` in surfaces/
hp.noSend: this deck has no headphone send — migrate the set (migrateSetCue) or connect `deck{side}.cue` in surfaces/
hp.noPair: this machine has no headphone pair — name one with `system cue 3+4`, or the cue plays nowhere
hp.on: deck {side} is in the headphones — click to take it out
hp.off: hear deck {side} in the headphones, before the crossfader
sync.tempoOnly: sync onto deck {side} — tempo only: the analysis found no reliable grid on one of the songs, so the beats will not line up
cue.noSong: cue {n} — this deck needs a song
cue.free: cue {n} — press and hold to put it here
cue.set: cue {n} at {at} — tap to go there, hold to set it again
deck.empty: deck {side} is empty — nothing to start
deck.stop: stop deck {side} — the other one carries on
wave.shuttle: drag left to go forward, right to go back — further is faster
meter.outClipped: output {value} — it clipped since playback started
fader.title: deck {side}'s level — {db} dB, double-click to go back to unity
fader.unwired: this deck has no channel fader wired — connect `deck{side}.level` in surfaces/
xfade.aria: crossfade between deck A and deck B
quantise.on: quantise: the loops and the jumps land on the beat
quantise.off: quantise off: they land where the hand puts them
knob.unwired: this deck has not got that module loaded
knob.title: {label} — drag to set, double-click to go back to neutral
stems.running: Separating ({phase}) — the knobs light up when it is done
stems.ready: Take an instrument out of the song
stems.unprepared: This song has not been separated — prepare the playlist (playlist stems), or name a chain in the surface's `stems:` so the desk does it itself
mix.noFileService: this machine's file service is not answering — the media library is unreachable
mix.tempoFailed: the tempo could not be corrected in the media library: {error}
mix.notInPlaylist: {song}: that song is not in this surface's playlist
mix.noAudio: {song}: the folder is catalogued but carries no audio
mix.noPlaylist: This surface names no playlist. Add a `playlist: <name>` line to `{file}` — the repository's playlists are written in k7, under the cog.
mix.listenTitle: The sound already leaves this machine's interface. Tick this to hear it in this tab as well.
mix.metronomeOff: the metronome asks for one beat: one deck loaded, or both synced — and a beat measured on the one that leads
mix.prewarm: analysing the playlist: {done}/{total} songs — an analysed song lays down its tempo and lights SYNC at once
mix.prewarmFailed: analysing the playlist: {done}/{total} songs ({failed} unreadable) — an analysed song lays down its tempo and lights SYNC at once
set.notFound: the playlist this surface names cannot be found
set.unreadable: this file does not read as a playlist
desk.mixUnread: {file} could not be read yet — the cue was not written
desk.cueFailed: the cue could not be written into {file}: {error}
desk.xfadeUnbound: the crossfade is bound to no loaded plugin — check {file}
video.noPicture: This project has no picture yet. Add `video_tracks/<name>.yaml` and a `viewport` in project.yaml.
video.cannotDraw: The picture cannot be drawn in this browser: {why}
lens.closed: the link to the machine closed
lens.noRelay: no camera relay on this machine
